## Notation Note (Spatial Algebra, Chapters 7–12)

Twists, wrenches, joint subspaces, parent indices, and bias symbols are
harmonised in [NOTATION.md](../../../NOTATION.md).
Canonical choices: angular-first twist $\mathcal{V}$, moment-first wrench
$\mathcal{F}$, parent index $\lambda(i)$, joint subspace $S_i$ (distinct from
PoE space screws $\xi_i$), manipulator bias $h(q,\dot q)$, and constraint
Jacobian $J_c$. Local reuse of $c$, $b$, $S$, or $f$ is flagged in the chapter
text where it occurs.
:::
